ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: Q3 2026 and Q2 2026 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

ratios.label: Operating margin
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the operating margin is -1049%, beyond the 500% bound past which a ratio cannot describe a real business, so the input behind it is wrong. A blank is honest; a ratio built on a wrong input is not a valuation.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity for FY2025 is -1.347e+12 (negative), so a P/B over negative book value is not meaningful. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on Q3 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the revenue behind this P/S is not a revenue - the 11.88m naira revenue row is a seventh of the period's own 80.78m net profit, so the row is filed in a different unit from the rest of the statement. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation. The market capitalisation behind this multiple records no price date, so the price it stands on cannot be audited.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 20.32 percent a year from FY2021 (3.8551e+07) to FY2025 (8.0784e+07), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.peRouteNote: The P/E reproduces from the market capitalisation and the FY2025 net profit, but the EPS on file is that same net profit over the same share count, so the per-share route and the cap route are one arithmetic: this agreeing flag is a reproduction check, not an independent one.
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are Q3 2026, an interim and not annualised.
